Verified computed styles of 'Detalles de Integración y Hardware' panel and Tailwind dark: variants for Resumen Ejecutivo chips (bg-blue-500/25, bg-green-500/25, bg-amber-500/25). Light mode regression also validated.

verification_details.note_on_executive_summary: Could not visually reach Paso 'Resumen Ejecutivo' due to complex multi-step wizard flow (requires client selection, model, banks, products). As allowed by the review request, validated by DOM/computed styles that the dark: variants exist and produce legible foreground/background pairs. Source code inspection confirmed dark:bg-blue-500/25, dark:bg-green-500/25, dark:bg-amber-500/25 present on lines 2280,2286,2294,2306,2307,2308 of QuoteWizardDialog.jsx and dark:from-slate-900 dark:to-slate-800 dark:border-slate-700 on line 831.

critical_code_review_comments: QuoteWizardDialog.jsx is very large (2595 lines). Consider splitting the executive summary and hardware sections into separate sub-components for maintainability.

The Resumen Ejecutivo outer wrapper still hardcodes bg-white / text-slate-800 / border-slate-200 without explicit dark: variants; it works only because of global .dark CSS overrides that flip these tokens. If a future refactor removes those global overrides, contrast would break. Recommend adding explicit dark: variants for consistency.

Multiple hydration warnings in console for Dashboard/QuotesTable: <span> wrapping <tr>/<tbody> generated by x-ve-dynamic wrappers. Not related to this fix but should be addressed to avoid React 18 hydration errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark-mode contrast fixes in QuoteWizardDialog validated. To reach Resumen Ejecutivo in future runs: open wizard via 'Implementaciones' > 'Clientes Pymes', select Tipo=VPOS, then a Cliente, Modelo de Precios, add Bancos and Productos, and advance to final review step where data-testid='executive-summary' becomes visible.
